description.fun: Passimian live in troops of 20 to 30 and play ball with Berries: they throw hard ones to hurt foes and soft ones to blind them, passing them around the team to confuse opponents, and whoever throws farthest becomes leader. Each troop wears its own pattern of leaves, stuck on with spit. A Passimian with a Trainer looks to them as its leader, and refuses to obey if they throw Poké Balls badly.
description.guide: Passimian is a Fighting-type Pokémon from Alola based on a lemur, and possibly an American football quarterback. It lives in highly coordinated troops and fights by throwing and passing Berries. It is a counterpart to Oranguru, and each appears in different game versions.
description.tagline: A team-player lemur that throws Berries like a quarterback
